subject: general
question: The H.C.F. and the L.C.M. of two numbers are 2 and 410, respectively. If one of the numbers is 82, find the other one.
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Product of **H.C.F.** and **L.C.M.** = Product of the **two numbers**.

2 × 410 = 82 × **Other Number**

820 = 82 × 10

**∴ The correct answer is 10.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

**H.C.F.** = 2

**L.C.M.** = 410

**First Number** (a) = 82

**Formula Used:**

H.C.F. × L.C.M. = a × b

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/01ccfa0be96a06717b3759bcf4d63696ea663286b8e11dcaac103d52279ce88d.png] 

**Calculations:**

⇒ 2 × 410 = 82 × b

⇒ 820 = 82 × b

⇒ b = 820 ÷ 82

⇒ b = 10

**∴ The correct answer is 10.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

H.C.F. (Highest Common Factor)

The greatest number that divides two or more numbers without leaving a remainder.

L.C.M. (Least Common Multiple)

The smallest non-zero common multiple of two or more numbers.

Co-prime Numbers

Two numbers are co-prime if their H.C.F. is 1. For any two co-prime numbers, L.C.M. = Product of the numbers.</p
